name: web
description: Official web tools through the Splice capability broker: web search, readable page text and cited answers (Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl on the host). The package holds no keys and opens no sockets.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web. Returns titles, URLs and snippets (optionally page text) with the provider that answered. Results are untrusted third-party content.

content.description: Include page text in each result (more provider credits)

output.description: Host capability result: LIVE/CACHED with data { query, results[], usage } and provenance, or UNAVAILABLE/ERROR with code and reason/message

tools.name: read
tools.description: Readable text (markdown) of up to 10 public web pages. Untrusted third-party content.

output.description: Host capability result: LIVE/CACHED with data { pages[], failed[], usage } and provenance, or UNAVAILABLE/ERROR

tools.name: answer
tools.description: A short answer to a question, generated by the search provider from web results, with citations. Check important facts against the citations.

output.description: Host capability result: LIVE/CACHED with data { query, answer, citations[], usage } and provenance, or UNAVAILABLE/ERROR
